milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit of Elder Hu fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; yields 100 Essence

milestones.name: Collect Love Key
milestones.note: Found on a large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens

milestones.name: Obtain Vengeful Spirit
milestones.note: Found as a Point of Interest in the Forgotten Crossroads area

milestones.name: Obtain Soul Catcher
milestones.note: Found as a Point of Interest in the Forgotten Crossroads area

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark murky hallways, curved lattice pattern background, enemies; contains Snail Shaman NPC, Baldur/Tiktik/Vengefly/Wandering Husk enemies, Vengeful Spirit, Soul Catcher, Whispering Root

zones.name: Temple Of The Black Egg
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area with marked and unmarked sections, distinct ambient music

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Memorial to Elder Hu is located above the gates to the City of Tears; site of Elder Hu boss fight

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe; referenced in Elder Hu lore

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location of the Love Key on a large dead Husk Dandy corpse

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit; also used to Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse holding the Love Key

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; allows dash through rings

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: Listed as a Point of Interest in Forgotten Crossroads

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Recommended alongside Shade Cloak for a Spell build to defeat Elder Hu quickly

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgrade to Howling Wraiths; recommended for Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Soul Catcher
abilities.note: Listed as a Point of Interest in Forgotten Crossroads; also part of recommended Spell build for Elder Hu

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; Dream Nailing the corpse yields dialogue

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage fought at his memorial above the City of Tears gates after acquiring Dream Nail. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Yields 100 Essence on defeat.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail to unlock the ability to fight Warrior Dream spirits such as Elder Hu

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to engage Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.note: Shade Cloak recommended; dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain, attack in gaps

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat Elder Hu to collect 100 Essence with the Dream Nail

objectives.name: Collect Love Key from Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Find and collect the Love Key held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; optionally Dream Nail the corpse for lore dialogue

objectives.name: Obtain Vengeful Spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and acquire Vengeful Spirit from its Point of Interest within Forgotten Crossroads

objectives.name: Obtain Soul Catcher
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and acquire Soul Catcher from its Point of Interest within Forgotten Crossroads
